A mysterious artifact uncovered in Egypt revealed the start of an ancient civilization
A team from the American University in Cairo unearthed a mysterious tomb filled with astonishing findings. The artifacts and discoveries will help scientists understand the Egyptians and their ancestors.
Although the tomb has been investigated since the beginning of the year, the details on the state of the tomb, its deteriorated condition, and the whole tomb’s contents are still unclear.
A team of researchers, led by a group of scientists from the American University in Cairo, examined the tomb, located in Giza Plateau, outside the Egyptian capital. While the tomb is huge, its origins are still unknown. It is believed that the tomb was constructed sometime during the 15th century B.C.E.
The team discovered an ancient Egyptian tomb called a sepulchral complex. This tomb is large, but is believed to be built on a structure called the Amenhotep II resting place, which was once a royal family shrine to the mummies of the former pharaoh.
Experts believe that Amenhotep II was buried on a small mound, while his female priestess was buried on the other side of the tomb.
The Archaeology of Giza and other ancient Egyptian tombs
The ancient Egyptians believed in a mummy cult. These tombs were usually made of stone, mud, and a jasmine vine that was used to encase the mummies inside the burial chamber.
There were also tombs constructed for royalty, which were located in the vicinity of the Amenhotep II mummies’ tomb.
Due to their age and complexity, the tombs were considered important locations, where mummies could be protected from the elements.
According to a report by A. Nassib, the tomb has long been a focus of archaeologists and experts.
The team discovered an old doorway, covered by a layer of vines. The secret passage is located in a small, enclosed courtyard. They also found another entrance, which leads to the southeastern side of the tomb.
It is believed that the original entrance of the tomb was opened to the outside world by a giant fire. After that, the tomb was sealed, causing it to rot.
Ancient Egyptians built many temples. During the Ptolemaic period, a great religious movement developed in Egypt. While the city of Thebes was the center of the ancient civilization, other cities like Alexandria and Karnak also became known for their religious beliefs.
The German archaeologist Ludwig v. Bunning built a temple to Ptolemy, which is believed to be one of the oldest in the world. In 1864, Egyptologist Giovanni Battista Cassaddei found 50 tombs on the outskirts of the city.
It was believed that these tombs had undergone decades of desecration. The purpose of these tombs was believed to be the tomb of the deceased pharaoh or the temple they were buried in.
The location of these tombs was unimportant, and it is believed that the tombs were not dug for religious purposes.
It is also believed that a select few tombs were always in use. The knowledge of tombs is not something that many people understand.
Ancient tombs are filled with gold, turquoise, and metallic bronze, gems, and even papyrus scrolls. These tombs have an estimated value of over 1 million Egyptian pounds ($13 million).
The Egyptians believed in living after death. Their famous mummies are now considered priceless, having been mummified more than 3,500 years ago. The mummies, which are still alive, had been buried on a nearby island, as a result of the Egyptian catastrophe.
What to do with the Egyptian Mummies?
Since it is believed that Egyptians believed in the idea of “ascending to eternal life.” While they buried their dead in the ground and decompose into water and fire, they often turned the corpse into mummies, which were then buried in a tomb.
In 1864, more than 50 tombs were found, of which only 20 were excavated.
The researchers who carried out the excavation were led by George John Briennig.
The tombs were found in far-off places. Many tombs are believed to have been built on sacred mountains. These tombs were very popular, especially during the Ptolemaic period. It is believed that in the late 5th century B.C.E., the so-called Golden Age of Egypt, the country lost its hold on the entire Middle East.
Egypt’s political and cultural relevance decreased, which is attributed to the growing interests of the new Arab nations and the declining influence of the mighty Roman Empire.
Although some of the tombs were discovered to have been lost, the majority of them were hidden and left untouched.
Through the excavation process, many mysteries were revealed. The experts have been able to discern the types of tools used by the people who built these tombs.
Ancient Egyptian Mummies
The Egyptians were skilled in engineering and architecture. It is believed that most tombs were built using the same techniques.
It was believed that the Egyptians were buried in large tombs, with a servant helping the deceased to the back. The entire process was completed using special mortars that were required for the tomb.
After the death of the deceased, the tombs were covered by a thick wall. After the wall was constructed, the tombs were covered with a layer of colored mud.
It is believed that the quality of the tomb was decided by the number of coffins and mummies inside the tomb.
More than 3,000 mummies were discovered in the tomb, and they had been relocated to other tombs.
Many researchers were attracted to the tombs. They were able to discover ancient cults that people used. It was believed that these cults were related to the belief of eternal life after death.
The purpose of the discovery was to be able to create a tomb of the dead that would not decay, making it eternal.
There is a lot to discover, and scientists will have to go back and read the ancient texts to understand the meaning of the artifacts.
Egypt’s Present
Egypt is located in North Africa, Northwest Asia, and the Red Sea area. The official languages are Arabic, French, English, and Russian.
Egypt has developed into a tourist destination with many tourists coming from different places. Most of the people come from around the world and are divided into different categories based on their needs.
According to the report published by Egypt Today, the number of people who visit Egypt in 2019 was around 3.5 million. The number of people who visit Egypt annually is around 10 million.

At dawn, the mountains cast shadows that seemed to dominate the sky, creating a magnificent scene that looked faraway. In a calm and quiet atmosphere, looking back to look over my shoulder, I saw the iconic peak of Mount Fuji, one of Japan’s most representative mountains, gleaming in the moonlight, a 3,792-meter high tip that should not be missed in any itinerary around Japan.
Fueled by an early morning breakfast and the energy of the mountain, I left the hotel at 6:30 a.m. After a 20-minute drive, we entered Mount Fuji’s Monasana Hakuenai-jin station, which looked like a quiet and well-kept town with an abundance of shops and restaurants, while we all took off our shoes and entered the station’s entrance.
Upon checking in, we headed straight to the signboard, waiting for the train to depart. On the narrow train tracks, I felt that life was in good hands as we waited for the blossoming cherry trees along the route.
We arrived at the beginning of the route, to be greeted by a unique mosaic made of cherry blossoms that shone with red and pink blooms, and then immersed in nature. The serene environment, along with the sound of the blossoming trees, gave us the sense of being in the forest.
It seemed that we had almost been running from the airport to the Monasana Hakuenai-jin station, a little on the edge of town and with no people, but it felt like we had travelled to another world, as we entered a calming landscape.
We finally left the city and, just after 8:00 a.m., arrived at the Fuji 5 station, where we changed into our own clothes and put on our hats. As we prepared for the ascent, we all felt the mountain looming behind us, creating a calming sensation.
There was a light jacket around our waists and a hat in our hands, and while being a little gusty, we walked along the mountain tracks through lush green pine trees, waking up the natural environment, and heading straight up to the top of Mount Fuji.
Looking at the sea of clouds that were hiding at an altitude of 19,000 meters, it felt as if the clouds were just floating in the middle of a blue sea. The viewing platform on top was occupied by a group of people who had made a beautiful ceremony.
When the sun rose, it was indeed a scene of breathtaking beauty as we stood on the Fuji 5 Station’s viewing platform. We felt that the moment had arrived when we had reached the top of Mount Fuji, and that was also when we finally felt the experience of being in Japan, so we walked to the top of the mountain to enjoy the panoramic views.
Although we thought it was not high season, it was still an amazing day in Hakone, especially as we were able to enjoy the fresh air that fell through the trees along the mountainside.
After finishing up, we had a bit of a leisurely walk back to the hotel, which felt a bit like a pleasant summer afternoon in Hakone’s countryside.
At the base of Mount Fuji, there was a restaurant and a souvenir shop at the top of the hill, called “Onigiri”—the latter literally means fresh rice and a type of food from a traditional Japanese dish that includes meat, raw vegetables, and rice.
You can experience the traditional cuisine at the mountain restaurant, “Onigiri,” which was almost an outdoor café that embodied a sense of freedom and a joyful atmosphere, where you can be surrounded by nature without having to be too far from the city center.
The main courses of the meal included fresh pork, various kinds of nigiri (rice balls), egg dishes, and “Itako,” which are seafood dishes with dashi, which consists of a budo (herb-soaked rice, safflower), pickles, and seabass, and is also a common meal in Japan.
In addition to the meals at “Onigiri,” there were also several restaurants at the base of Mount Fuji that were offering meals and drinks, and a café with a view that was the perfect location to enjoy the stunning sunset.
After finishing up, we ended up not eating very much at “Onigiri,” but instead got into a 12-kilometer-long hiking trail, called “Fuji Trail,” by taking a taxi back to the city center.
The trail also gave a beautiful view of the city, with blossoming cherry trees at the top, which provided a delightful contrast between green and red, and after finishing it, we walked around the city’s city gates, which once again gave us that calm and peaceful sensation, as if we had entered a temple where we had been taken to a heavenly paradise.
It was at this moment that we saw the body of two Russian-Japanese men who had collapsed in front of Mount Fuji. Although the situation was unfortunate, it seemed that they had already received the best of fortune as the sun was setting, with lush greenery and a perfect light.
I began thinking about the many people who have died while climbing in the mountains, as if they were preparing for a great feast of happiness, and it was as if it was about to happen.

The young inventor's new device promised to revolutionize the relationship between machines and humans
Tuesday November 13 2017
The world of 3D printing continues to improve, and there are still improvements to be made. The latest development in this revolution is the ability of a device known as the 3D Mimicking Bio-robot, to control digital 3D models of bacteria in the lungs of a human to perform an internal examination. The 3D Mimicking Bio-robot, which was developed by the 3D University, is currently being tested in an experimental phase and could improve many kinds of non-invasive surgical procedures.
Like many 3D printing projects, this 3D Mimicking Bio-robot is a machine based on a lot of plastic. The 3D Mimicking Bio-robot itself is made of an iron oxide and acrylic mixture, which is able to reproduce human cells' complex tissues and organs without the need of a bone marrow, fetal brain, nerve and even a vein.
Inside of the robot, a box of micro-parts called "protoplanes" is placed to allow their genetic information to be transcribed into the desired cells, and to verify the growth of cells. In fact, this box of protoplanes is what allows for the movement of cells to reach the desired location, while the robot uses force to make sure cells in uninhabitable areas are not pushed. In addition, the prototype was modified to have LEDs inside the box, so the 3D Mimicking Bio-robot could be lit in dark areas, such as where blood has been cut off, by injecting the black plastic box with a light source.
However, despite all of these benefits, the robot is still in the experimental phase and the team still has many things to improve, such as that the robot has to be more precise and has to be able to be more precise than 100 millimetres. In this case, the problems are very similar to the problems in 3D printers, although in this case, the robot does not only transmit digital information, but also physical information. The robot is designed to replace the metal grid on the front of the chest, which allows it to track the internal organs and the inside of the body. This means that, for example, when the robot gets into contact with the heart, it can be able to perform various types of heart tests, using the built-in multimodal sensors.
While the robot can be programmed to move in certain directions and perform tasks, the robot cannot perform any jobs that involve moving parts larger than 15 millimetres, and this is why the 3D Mimicking Bio-robot is designed to be controlled by human assistance. The project is currently underway, and is aiming to create a small version of the robot to be used in medicine.

The mysterious stranger in town had a story that made people run.
A train in the snow passed through, the guy in the trolley told the woman behind the counter: If the train was moving, he couldn’t help you.
The woman had given the man the identity of a guide.
The woman had even given him a gun.
A year later, two strangers would come to meet at a village inn to talk about the woman they had met, and to tell their stories.
The first story was the one that was told to me.
I met an old friend of mine.
We had both lived in this tiny hamlet deep in Newfoundland. We knew we had to talk soon.
After a few days, he knocked on my door.
“Mister Tim,” he said.
“Can I borrow your car?” I asked.
“No, I’ve just the old farmhouse, I can’t rent it.” The man had a house and a yard. “The town is really small. Your car would get stuck if you tried to leave without me driving it, so here it is for you.” He gave me his keys and I got behind the wheel. He turned the car’s lights on and off as he sped down the road.
I didn’t see the man again after that, but as I walked away from town, I wondered if I had made a real friend in this quiet village.
The second story was the one I knew best.
That story belonged to a writer named John Fleming, who lived in Carmenfield, Alberta. The woman he met in his story was called Alice.
When I met her I didn’t know how to ask her about herself. When I finally did, the stories became my focus. I began to write about them and sometimes to go and see them in the village.
I had a couple of friends in town who asked me what I thought of their friend Alice, and I knew I had to tell them the stories.
I told them about her unusual lover, John Spencer, who refused to change his nature. I told them how she treated him like his whole life. They listened to the stories, and as I continued I discovered that the men in the stories had an unusual connection with Alice, and with their unusual stories she told them were theirs to tell.
And then one day I found myself driving my new friend’s car around town.
He hadn’t mentioned me once, so I figured he had forgotten about me. When I finally got home, his car was parked near the village hall.
“How was it?” I asked.
He shook his head and said “It’s too late. It’s too late.” I sighed and told him I was going to go and find the old woman I had met with a year earlier.
It was going to be a long, long drive. I had to change and get ready. It would be early morning by the time I got home.
I asked my old friend if he had brought me an antique tea light he had brought in from Newfoundland, but the old man said, “No, I never brought anything in.”
As I drove through town I couldn’t help but notice all the people in the storefronts, the tiny shops, the houses.
I went inside the old woman’s house. It was completely secluded. All the things in the house were theirs, and the things they owned, and they were all filled with boxes.
“How can I live here,” I asked. “How do you make it?”
“You don’t need to know that,” the woman replied.
I found a pile of boxes next to her.
I opened one of the boxes, and I found an antique tea light that I had not noticed before. Inside it was packed and unpacked and wrapped in green wool. It was hard to understand what the old woman was looking for. But when I opened the tea light, I saw the word that had been sewn in.
“Can you help me, Mr. Wood?” she said.
I stared at the tea light, at its soft glow.
Then the woman explained to me the story of her special person, her extraordinary story.
But then, for a moment, I wondered if I had made a friend in this small village.

Trees and grains among my favorite subjects in photography.
If your home has walls for porches, they're sometimes built with large, unfinished windows that present an interesting and recognizable profile for the homeowner to show visitors. They're also good for baking bread; a laundry basket of towels is common.
But sometimes we want to change the view of our home, so we add a door to the porch, or install a deck or patio. Doing so changes the look of the home, but we know this decorative trick affects the natural balance and harmony of a home. As a result, we seek new ways to make our homes more comfortable for our inhabitants.
The easy answer is to paint walls, but this is a bit of a cheat. It has to look like it's a solid wall, even if it's a painted wall. It doesn't help that most walls are plastered, covered with tiles, or carved from brick. Because of its consistency, it can be hard to cut a perfectly straight line from one wall to the next.
Other cheats are to add other types of exterior coverings, such as a screen door. It may look like your home has an underground swimming pool, but the underground pool has a tiled surface and doesn't seem very natural.
So what do you do to make your home's existing design more balanced?
Grow roots
If you plant new shrubs and flowers, and especially if you use multiple types of shrubs and flowers, you'll add an interesting layer to the garden. The colors you plant help to accentuate natural borders that make it seem as if you've grown something inside. But even if you just keep a few plants, you'll have a stronger sense of cohesion in the garden.
Of course, you have to know how to grow shrubs and flowers. If you're worried about how the tree will grow, see if there's a safe spot to place the root ball. Here you can plant all kinds of root balls.
Alternatively, use a rotting tree to enhance the look of your yard. To maintain this type of shrub, you'll need to plant different varieties of shrubs and trees at varying levels. They'll give the yard an airy look and become layered against the grass.
The best trees and shrubs for the garden are bare root shrubs that show off their roots.
Little "boxes" of shrubs or trees can be created by inserting a pair of plastic pipe sections into existing holes. This technique looks like a garden for the birds, and it also allows you to move shrubs and trees from one location to another, without taking up too much space.
Of course, you'll want to make sure you do this the right way.
Insulating the walls
What you don't want is thick walls for a house with floors that run out to the street. Weight gain from a wall leads to the loss of that weight. It's true that walls help create insulation, but if you use just enough of them, the warmth will still get through.
If you're going to put a wall up, make sure it doesn't offer too much structural resistance. The right amount is a function of the type of material and the area of the wall. Look at the joints on the edge of a wall, and especially at the location where one wall meets the other. You can do this with a trowel.
Perhaps it's time to install energy-saving insulation in your walls. New solar panels can provide light and heat for an area, and your insulation isn't that bad to look at. You can even be as simple as topping it with wool or insulation foam.
Create an inexpensive planter
In the winter, flowers are in their prime and these make a nice addition to the planting. By placing an abundance of bright yellow or pink flowers at the foot of a wall in your garden, they'll make the garden look more spacious. Even better, you can reuse this display: a planter can be added to the back of a hanging basket.
This arrangement doesn't have a problem with rain. It can also be moved on a stand, making it easy to place in a corner of the garden. Use this planter for a lot of natural floral arrangements or small, but interesting, potted plants. And don't forget about all those water lilies.
Wall color
Painting the exterior walls of a home is a great way to add a splash of color. Think of the color used to paint the shutters and doors. But once the main color is applied, it's tough to change it without some serious damage to the interior walls.
You could sand the exterior of the walls and it will look better. However, that can cause interior damage. Once you've settled on the color of the exterior walls, use a paint sprayer and apply two coats of paint to the inside. Use a thin layer of primer on the interior of the home to further soak up any damage.
If you want to do this a DIY project, use an epoxy primer on the outside and then a thin coat of paint on the inside. That way, you can choose which coat you want to use, or which one will offer you the best results.

The lone hiker's journey across the desert tested the limits of her resilience.
by Heather Cladwell | October 29, 2018
Travel is amazing! But it can also be quite scary, especially when you’re the lone hiker for a three-day trek.
But that’s where I’m going to take off from my most recent adventure, this weekend when I’ll hike 24 miles from the Sunset Crater Visitor Center to the summit of the 2,112-foot granite peak in the Cinder cone of the Joshua Tree National Park. On top of that, I will be the only female hiker through the entire trek, taking on the challenge of carrying 52 pounds of gear, navigating 500-foot switchbacks, and slogging through 1,500-foot swamps, sand dunes, and massive washes.
“I just feel invincible,” says Heather Stone, a Carlsbad, Calif.-based spokeswoman for Amber Alert. “It’s kind of like riding a wave. You can catch it and then get up on it again.”
She found it just as she did.
Stone traveled to Joshua Tree with a trio of 15-year-old girls. The three-day trip is a program designed for girls ages 12 to 14 to experience outdoors by increasing their understanding of the environment, helping build self-confidence, developing leadership skills, and establishing healthy lifestyles.
The girls, in turn, shared with Stone their expectations and hopes for the trek. And they asked her a very thought-provoking question.
“What do you expect this to be like?” Stone asked them.
The girls, who range in age from 14 to 18, didn’t blink. They all had visions of how to prepare for the trek. One looked into her backpack. Another looked into hers. Some had each other’s backs. They had their plastic shoes but didn’t wear them. One had some cooking gear and a sleeping bag, but didn’t want to risk walking barefoot across the desert floor.
“What I expect it to be like is a lot like living life on your own,” Stone says. “Everybody has a vision.
“Some people are going to be really fit and, like, ‘I’ve got to do it right now,’ and some people are just, ‘I’ll do it.’ And I think you’ll see how different the girls are. Some might be like, ‘No, I’ll do it,’ and some might be like, ‘I’ll make it work.’”
At the age of 15, both of the girls are taking advantage of the program’s limited enrollment and want to spend a full day hiking with the experienced staff. But most of all, they are overwhelmed with excitement and anticipation for what will be a challenging, but rewarding adventure.
“There are different levels of encouragement for the girls,” Stone says. “Some girls are, like, ‘I want to do this.’ And some girls are, like, ‘I’m just gonna follow behind the girls.’ ”
During the first day of the trip, Stone led the girls from the main parking lot to their vehicles. As they returned to their vehicles to begin the hike, one girl stepped on a fallen rock and her knee started to swell. Another needed some help assembling a tent.
“It took me back to my 12-year-old self,” Stone says. “I remember it so clearly, so vividly. It’s been 12 years since I experienced something like that.”
One of the girls’ mothers, Ellie, led the other girls through a hard, sandy wash where they had to walk the thin wooden sticks that the girls would be carrying through the thick tumbleweed and swamp.
“They came all the way back here from Mission Basin to help me walk through the thing that makes my heart ache,” Ellie says.
“I had to look for a rock,” Stone says. “I’m not even trying to make this stuff up. I was just looking for something solid underneath.”
“I think I’m gonna fall down and stay down,” Ellie says.
Eventually, Ellie finished with her girls and they returned to the car lot. As the sun started to set, they left and began the long descent back to their vehicles.
After their return trip, the girls told Stone they had enjoyed the first day.
“I don’t know if I ever want to do this again, but that was fun,” Ellie says. “I learned a lot of new things.”
One girl in particular was excited for a new challenge.
“I felt like I could use it,” says Jessica McCarthy. “I was exhausted, but I didn’t want to stop. I was having so much fun.”
“I really enjoyed every second of it,” Ellie says.
It’s taken 41 days to reach the summit of Cinder. On the third and final day of the hike, the group reached the trailhead. They made the 10-mile descent to the base of the climb. The girls were pleased to find their water back. The girls, who had only carried one gallon backpacks, each found a 5-gallon jug and carted it back to the car, plus the rope they had just pulled across the floor of a cavern. The girls will return the water to the base of the climb during the following days.
“They were like, ‘Oh, my goodness, I’m so close to the top,’ ” Ellie says.
“It’s so hard to say, but I just think the girls enjoyed it. I loved it,” Stone says.
“It was my first time hiking up to the crater and seeing the huge granite boulders.”
During her trip, Stone was struck by the beauty of the Joshua Tree’s landscape and by her new friendships.
“I realized that I wanted to do more like this,” she says. “I started looking around the world for the next big challenge.”
To learn more about the girls’ newfound friendship, read Stone’s memoir, “Let’s Make the Road,” on the Amber Alert website.
This story was provided to the Banner by Heather Cladwell, a Carlsbad, Calif., spokeswoman for Amber Alert.

During a board game night that becomes reality, players find themselves in a life-sized game of Poker at their local casino. The tables turn and cards are face up, but each player is trying to decide who the “three-of-a-kind” have been dealt.
The winner is determined at random, and unbeknownst to the players, the third card could be revealing information that could have led the winner to have an advantage in the future.
Among the players is bartender Daniel, who is sure that he knows the right card, but is unsure if he’s the one to deal. Despite his uncertainty, he plays the game, and with no blind bet and no fixed result, he tries to gather information from the card.
One of the players, Ellen, is also a casino employee and fan of blackjack. She finds herself trying to find out who the “three-of-a-kind” are in order to beat the dealer. She plays the game, and even though she’s the one in the largest stake, she’s pretty sure she is the only one who knows what her playing partner is actually doing, as she never saw the cards before.
The last player, Oscar, is a beer brewer by trade, but he’s a charter member of the Blackjack Club. He makes his way to the top table with the players, but then he gets dealt the three-of-a-kind card, and in an effort to beat the dealer, he is compelled to take out the huge chip. He plays the game, and this time, he wants to avoid the three-of-a-kind, because he doesn’t want to miss the opportunity to strike a winning bet.
When the game begins, all cards are dealt face-up and players aren’t allowed to look at their hands before they bet. Players begin placing their bets, and the first player to reach the 50/50 bet amount wins. All players must wager at least 50 units of money, and if the players find the three-of-a-kind that they dealt when they are playing, the player must lose the 100.
The best way to win in Poker, says the director of the film, is to play the game with good luck and by paying attention to the players. The film’s description makes it clear that the film is an inspection of the value of blackjack, and blackjack is not to be the game for the gambler.
Players and casinos have a lot in common. They provide social interaction, entertainment, and opportunities to gamble. The biggest differences between the two, however, are that blackjack is played with a count, and the value of the cards is added to the stakes. The difference is significant.
In blackjack, the stakes are quite high. If the player’s chip value is too low, then he or she can either give up and play with the next card, or they can bet to the bank or to the table with the players in it. A high stake gives the players a sense of danger.
In blackjack, the players can change their bets at any time, and they do so often. Players can’t pay attention to the stakes, and they will bet more than they should.
In the game, the players have a variety of advantages, such as a small prize pool for the winners, an opportunity to play for free, and an opportunity to play for cash prizes. The casinos also enjoy the rush of the experience. Players enjoy knowing that they are playing a game with the best of the best, and that they could be in for a big win.

Drifting through the cosmos, the comet harbors the ability to display the mysteries of the universe for the rest of its time. We want to know more about its components and composition; no such questions are possible without knowing how the comet was formed.
Our molecular clock measures from the Sun.
The comet’s surface shows a track of radiation as a result of leaving the inner solar system. The bright solar spot is converted into a comet mark, and its path is traced in the comet’s orbit.
The comet’s surface is icy and the bulk of the comet is covered by ice. A squeeze of material brings water to the surface; the water forms stains and circles on the comet. Water is frozen and cools into droplets.
The core is formed in the same way as the comet’s outer shell. The comet is susceptible to explosions from the core collapsing and causing a shock wave to the surrounding space. The shock wave forms a pressure pump that works to raise the temperature of the frozen interior. Ice is lowered to a temperature of 277 degrees Kelvin. Comets are stable to heat and may pass the sun, but they do not increase the temperature of the comet.
The ionosphere is a vortex, where hydrogen and other ions move in an electrically charged state. On the surface of the comet, the ions and the hydrogen shell are charged to give rise to electric fields that push the ions into opposite directions.
Nature breaks the electromagnetic radiation down into a ghostly radio wave. The ghostly radio wave transforms into electromagnetic radiation that is less violent and keeps the energy within the field around the comet intact.
The comet contains up to 500 volatile substances, including ammonia, methane, methane sulfide, carbon dioxide, nitrogen, and water. Atmospheric gases are primarily from these substances, the composition of which matches the presence of specific substances on the surface of the comet. Scientists have therefore hypothesized that the comet is primarily formed from volatile materials.
In this work, we examine the materials that can compose the comet. We see that the comet has a white color and a blue hue, from their polarity to their pH. The volatiles have been tracked and some of them have been measured.

Every full moon, a secret garden reveals a path to healing
October 16, 2020By Jayne Whitmer
The long-discussed Black Car Line skate park on the former Bradford Industrial Park in downtown Bettendorf, Iowa
It was July 2020 when I stumbled into the dark world of Bettendorf, Iowa. A small Midwestern city known for it’s manufacturing products and railroads, I arrived on a summer day with a vague plan to explore. The city had been hit hard by the COVID-19 pandemic, and was closed to tourists until then, so not only was I disappointed I couldn’t stop by to catch a glimpse of Bettendorf’s quaint town and its economic revitalization efforts, but it was difficult to find a place to stay. After a few days of endless confusion, I found the Black Car Line Skate Park on a rainy day and discovered a door that wasn’t locked.
My find was a shocking departure from the typical trip-based motel chain, though, and led me to a quiet path.
My first visit on the Black Car Line
The skate park, as it’s called, opened its doors in 2019 to a largely local community looking to do something that was needed at the time: give back to the city. Bettendorf, as I was later to learn, is home to the Black Car Industrial Park, one of four railroad car yards in the state of Iowa. The industrial park itself covers 26 acres of railroad land and makes up 30 percent of Bettendorf’s industrial base. The yards were closed to the public after industrial companies like Norfolk Southern shut them down to comply with COVID-19 health standards. Black Car Line, an effort of the local community, was the only way to get the facilities back up and running again.
This adventure was planned months in advance, and as an avid skateboarder, my trek to Bettendorf was not short on exercise. Wearing a mask at all times, I plunked down about $150 to rent the park. So, I’ve been back again, a few times now, over the last couple of years, to explore what’s left of Bettendorf. The park is named after a restored Old Orchard Mill on the property, built by the late Daniel Alexander Buchanan in 1850, a world-renowned inventor in the industrial age, born in Bettendorf. The man whose product was a light bulb made the town his home, before moving his family to the newly established city.
A glimpse of the Bettendorf skate park
As a newcomer to the skate park, I had no idea what I was in for. Sure, there were giant ramps with long rails, and long ledges for small boarders, but it didn’t feel right. This may have been a twinge of impatience as my friends had suggested to me to try the newly constructed dog park.
Over the next few months, I slowly learned the art of sneaking away to check out the skate park at different times of the day, when it was at its busiest. I would take the day off work, and leave the office behind at the wrong hours.
Although some were unsure of whether I’d return, it wasn’t long before I began to pick up a small community in Bettendorf again. I was practically run off by others who came to the park and learned how to skateboard on it. I stuck to that small community, and it got me really excited about the skate park. By January 2021, I was relocating from California to Bettendorf to finish my work and was excited to see what lay ahead.
Once I began to hear about the skate park back in Bettendorf, I began to imagine a secret garden that I hadn’t known existed in town. I started to feel like there was something waiting for me when I visited the skate park.
Much to my surprise, Black Car Line just made it easier to explore. The park hosts rangers to meet the visitors, and various public and private events are held throughout the year.
As I returned to the skate park, I remembered the time I started to feel a bit lost, when I asked if there was anything special about the skate park.
“We have to welcome everyone,” said Bob, the park ranger. “That is one of the things we are here for. A lot of people want to learn about it. A lot of people want to do it, but also want to have fun and meet new people.”
It was a warm summer day, and so I continued to discover a new secret garden that I hadn’t yet seen at the skate park. I went off the ranger’s path and walked toward a single ramp.
Almost immediately, I was overcome with disbelief. Just off the main ramp were a few decks, with regular flat rails and grinding boxes and pumps. I looked around for another skate park, but there were no park managers, no information boards, and I wasn’t quite sure if there was anything there.
I then saw the main ramp as I approached. The entire ramp was adorned with wooden slats that the park managers had built up to create a platform, meant for a bowl. A new addition, but more steep than I had ever seen before.
The beach-like ramp would have been perfect for a park manager, and led to the best bowl in town.
On the ramp
A hole appeared as I waited. I stepped over it and saw that it was much deeper than I had seen from the edge. It dropped down another few feet, into a steep cliff, and I knew I couldn’t go back. I wondered, maybe I’ll see something else, but this was it.
A stunning bowl in a secret garden
There were some other small decks and a few ramps here and there. I watched the ranger walk up and down the large ramp with someone.
“I don’t know,” I thought to myself, not sure how I wanted to begin to explore.
“Be careful,” I thought to myself, remembering the time I almost fell to my death over the last time I visited.
As I walked further into the hidden garden, I made my way around the ramp and went down to the surface of the cliff. The ramp was very steep, and I saw other people with no problem on their backs, walking up and down the slope without care, so I knew I was taking a mistake.
Tucked into the deep part of the garden, I walked around the perimeter until I was alone. I pushed my way into the path of that small box, and, low and silent, I practically came to a stop as I stood on the edge.
Another large group was having a party on the park land. I made a little noise, and they all screamed at me to get back. I immediately retreated into the box, and then went back into the garden as I knew I couldn’t go back there.
I didn’t want to just sit there, so I started to walk around and check the hidden parts of the park. At the bottom of the large grassy hill, there were lots of stones, small piles of earth and small hills in the middle of the grounds. My footsteps snaked through these, finding patches of grass here and there.
I laid down on the grass. It was late afternoon, and it was pleasant.
An isolated area in the park
The grasses were very dry, and had been used for hay, apparently. I was able to catch my breath, then noticed another gravel hill, also very dry, used to store materials.
The beach-like wall of gravel
This area was not the most natural area of the garden, and felt strange. As I lay down again, I thought I was in another city, with no city skyline.
I went to the small flat area at the top of the hill and found an enormous bowl with a few little decks and tables around it. It was another sight from another city. At the center of the bowl was an enormous concrete monster with wires going everywhere, one that seemed to be floating through the air.
The concrete structure with wires
Around the bowl were little wooden pads for boarding, and I got down on these, just to see what was down there. As I stood over the large concrete bowl, I realized it was no ordinary bowl.
Concrete bowl with wires inside

The bowl was built out of a solid, fairly durable concrete, covered in wires, and I assumed it would be kind of like a skate park, but in a way I’d prefer. I was ready to get going.
I laid down on the gravel and the ground withdrew around me as I walked.

A different kind of island in the park
All in all, the park is mostly empty during the day. I was glad that it was so quiet on a Wednesday afternoon in late summer.

Wet grassy island

As I walked around the bowl, I saw the raised concrete walkways that led down into the bowl. A hole appeared where the concrete had washed away over the years, and I had a lump in my stomach.

I watched a curious, tiny cricket walk down the grass. I was alone in that moment, and couldn’t help but think of another time in the park I’d forgotten about.
A cricket on grass in a hidden garden
I fell, and as I was getting up again, I landed at the bottom of the bowl. All of the water pond in the bowl was gone, and I could see that I was completely drenched.
I got up, but wet as I was. The water looked as though it was still sitting at the bottom of the bowl. As I got up, I noticed some water drops still sitting on the concrete.
I continued to walk through the bowl, just feeling like I wanted to wash it. Finally, I walked over and onto the rock.
I was completely drenched, in a park no longer. I let the water drip down the rock, but I was stuck there.
“I don’t know,” I said to myself as I let the water drip.
I lay down on the edge of the rock.
The tree roots in the rock’s base had broken off
I lay there for a while. I didn’t know what to do.
A tree that once grew above the water pond, but is now rotting
The park was so quiet that I heard some nature sounds. There was the thunder, the wind and the rain. A small hill was in the distance, but it was still dead quiet.
In the distance, I could see the redoubtable boulder in the park. I began to think of how to get home, and wanted to get out of there as soon as possible.
The tree roots in the rock’s base had broken off, and the branches were on the side of the rock.
I looked down at the bottom of the rock, and saw a set of stairs, so that it looked as though I could walk down. But I didn’t know how to get down there.
I looked around to see if I could see any vegetation. I could see the planted grass and the faint hints of bushes that were once in this area, but that had disappeared.
A green area, but mostly dried up
I kept walking along the rock, and saw another little black island, a small platform on the rock. I took a few steps across, and noticed that the only thing on the island was a rock climbing wall. It didn’t look like it was meant for climbing, so I stepped back a bit.
I checked a few times over the platform to see if there were any water anywhere in the park. I got down on the platform, and the only water in the park was the water in the bowl. I closed the platform and walked away, thinking about what I’d do when I got home.
From here, the rock to the platform looked nothing like the rest of the park. The rocks were perfectly smooth, much harder than the rest of the rock I’d seen in the park. I found the idea very odd, but I moved on.
Near a set of stairs
Ahead of the stairs, I found some very dark, very dry rock, a few patches of mud, and some cracked rocks that had disappeared. All around me was dark, dry, cracked rock.
I could see the concrete walkway in the bottom of the bowl, but the rest of the park was in darkness.
It was then that I heard the sound of thunder. It didn’t sound far away, but it was enough that I knew it had to be coming my way.
As I continued to walk around the park, I continued to notice the trees, and there were at least two trees that grew on the rock. One was actually big, with small black leaves. It was very dead, in its own small way.
The only other black leaves were on the rock
There was a big, dead tree that was in the park, as well. I kept walking, following the black leaves to a path that led to an expansive path that led to the park’s tree house.
The black leaves covered the branches of the dead tree
The park’s tree house was empty.

The tree house that had been so empty

Unraveling the mysteries of the deep sea, researchers find 4 new types of deep sea fish
Sabrina Morad	@sabrinamorad / 1 year
Startups like Seaspan, Interisle and Sailfish are developing the capability to raise ‘microfish’ in the sea. It’s a useful way to fish, but these recent studies might offer new insights into what kinds of organisms live in the bottom of the sea.
The recent research from a team of scientists from the University of Washington and University of California, Santa Cruz, reports on the 4 new types of deep sea fish found — blue pelagics, shortfin sand shrimp, dauphin tuna and sea urchins.
The new species are each better suited to different types of ecosystems than the other species.
The researchers found that the shortfin sand shrimp, the largest fish in the phylum Teleostei, can only be found in reefs, where they consume whole prey species. Blue pelagics can reproduce with annual reproductive phases and are also found in reefs and can have a higher incidence of disease in their populations. Sea urchins, on the other hand, reproduce once a year and are more likely to be a target for catch-and-release fishing by recreational fishers.
The new species were discovered after scientists sampled about 100 square miles of the South Sea, an area on the Eastern coast of the Pacific Ocean. They were more likely to be abundant on the sea floor, around fishing grounds, on coral reefs and at the bottom of sand dunes.
Aside from the interesting information on new species, the team conducted more genetic research. Scientists used a technique called GENDARS to examine the mitochondrial DNA of the fish, which is inherited from the parent and from each other. They found that of the 250 fish sampled, all were descendants of a single ancestral parent.
What we know about the properties of pelagics
We know that dauphin tuna only occur in high-latitude waters and are reproductively remoten. The group of fish was called Pteroplesus unicolor by their original authors.
Researchers also found that shortfin sand shrimp, which was not genetically well-diversified, did well in high-latitude waters but was found in reefs, sand and mud. They also found four new species of demersal fish, which are commonly caught for recreational purposes in the eastern Atlantic.
The findings represent a chance to look at what kind of healthy organisms might inhabit the bottom of the sea. While the species found were small, it’s good to know that there are lots of things out there that are teeming with organisms that may have a role in a number of important ecosystems.

A diary from the 18th century reveals life stories and secrets about a soldier
Alison Peden
Sir Archibald Alexander Brown has been an expert in the Napoleonic wars, with his talks including his work in the Library of Congress. His diary is now being used in the library’s collection at Warwick Castle. (Photo: Warwick Castle/Facebook)
When it’s noon, I make my way through the queues to the staff section of the 18th-century library at Warwick Castle. The castle is famous for its exhibition of Napoleonic wars’ weapons and artefacts, but I am here to visit its fascinating diaries – and to take the nineteenth-century’s habits with me.
Five years ago, the diaries came to me from the National Archives. The Archive had no idea what they were, but they had been found in a sitting room next to the library at the National Archives. For years, it was assumed that they were a bundle of registers for the archives, which always seem to hold a special kind of treasure for them – an arsenal of letters from soldiers in the Napoleonic wars.
But the volunteers who now check them out from the Archives knew little about the war’s details, so they started with the first page: 1817. “On August 22nd,” it reads, “the government of England ordered troops to re-establish the line of defence between the town of Tarentum and Victricole on the Plain of Sands.” A month later, Tarentum was in occupation, so that’s when soldiers came to visit.
The most common letters that troops sent to the Castle from 1818 onward were sent by women from a general, recounting their husband’s wellbeing, family problems, and sicknesses. A soldier’s letter to his family was usually less likely to contain some juicy gossip, but that’s what I found in these letters.
“Dear Madam," one soldier wrote in 1820 to his young wife. "I wish to congratulate your son on getting a commission to the regiment. His behaviour, himself, and all others in the regiment have been excellent. The regiment was in command this evening. In fact, they were so well pleased that they enjoyed themselves and were very happy. If this don’t speak of our dear regiment, then you may depend upon us doing better.”
I found the letters to be deeply human, but I also found new information. The national safety of the country was not guaranteed to troops when they were first sent out on the front line, and each soldier must have wondered whether his family, friends, and health could be safe in France.
One letter from a soldier, “Charles”, details the soldier’s experience as a musician in the 54th Regiment of Foot. When his regiment was called to camp, the 54th Regiment had the lowest percentage of German prisoners. Many of the prisoners used the issue as a military token to gain parole. Charles’s diary confirms that he served for three years in France, and he was told in February 1818 that he was to go back to England in a few weeks.
Charles’s letter to his wife is filled with hints about his experiences, and I began to suspect that as the letters show, some soldiers’ stories were meant to keep their own secrets. For example, Charles’s wife expresses her relief when Charles is recommended for medical attention. “Have been sending your cousin below to me,” she writes. “It is impossible to tell how his suffering is created. They have done all they can with the vast quantity of beef and fish they were at the camp. This keeps the poor men occupied for the remainder of the day – the next one will bring more meat.”
Charles later reports that he went to France in December 1818 “with the smallest portion of the French beef, the largest portion of their cheese, and many kind and good baked goods.” On returning to England, Charles himself was able to afford “a very good plate of stouffed burgers, upon very good meats, in a very fresh pair of clawed gloves.”
If these were typical letters, it’s impossible to know what they would have said. The soldiers were human and the soldiers’ writing was human. I found the diaries soaking up my thoughts and thoughts of war.
Alison Peden is the winner of the 2018 Munster Poetry Competition, and she is a teacher at St. Joe’s National School, Killeally, County Waterford.

The entrance of the forest could be heard from the outside of the building, though it was not the main entrance.
The entrance to the underground temple was located underneath the City Wall, beneath the London wall. The City Wall was the old outer border wall surrounding the River Thames, where all four of the main railway lines were connected. The City Wall's eastern end was marked by the small bricks' and mortar stalls of traders. The western end was marked by the well-known London Wall of Jack in the Stock Exchange, the biggest building in London.
Underneath the City Wall, a secret network of tunnels and catacombs leading to a number of underground royal crypts, began to date back to Roman times. The underground fortress was used for Roman raids to subdue any resisting inhabitants. The fortress included walls of reinforced brick, iron and brick, the largest of these being known as Caesar's Wall. The Roman's also constructed a moat outside the City Wall. It is believed that the City Wall was built around a Roman Temple of victory to coincide with the Roman's invasion of Britain.
Within these tunnels, royalty was kept hidden and guarded. These tunnels were also the residence of the Archdukes and Dukes. During medieval times, the only fire, watch and prayer guardian was the Archduke (so named for his grandfather) from the Archduke's Tomb. These tunnels also had hidden war rooms and stairwells. During the Middle Ages, these were the Royal residences for the royal court and the royal staff and their families. On the London Wall outside the City Wall, at the west end of it there was a tourist attraction called The London Wall. It also marked the spot where the London wall stood and where the remains of Jack the Ripper are buried.
The king's residence was inside the central area of the City Wall. These include stables, quarters for royal horses, apartments for royal stewards, the government offices, the palace, the main City Hall, the Council Chamber, treasury, pub, the Queen's Chapel and a gift shop. This area also contained the Archduke's Tomb, where the remains of the most famous person to ever died in London, including the Archduke's brother and Queen, are kept. These are the ruins of what was known as the Tower of London, or the Queen's Gate, which was once an underground castle and citadel. The remains of the tower are thought to have dated back to Roman times. Inside this area of the City Wall is a large plaque which was inscribed by Queen Elizabeth. The Queen's Name is carved into this, from the stone they are resting on.
At this area, a secret door led to a tunnel to the west of the City Wall. This led to the entrance to the Temple of Sage and Moon which was built between the middle ages and the 19th century. The Temple of Sage and Moon was dedicated to religious purposes and to healers who performed supernatural healing techniques. At this time of the temple, it was said to be a favorite place for worshippers of ancient spirits and fairies. Unfortunately, one of the doors to the Temple of Sage and Moon was not firmly closed and instead led to the public park which covered the ruins of a once grand palace and garden. The London Underground (City Underground) and the City of London have similar names. Like all of London, they were first referred to as the City of London in 968. The City of London was given the designation London Underground in 1857. The last letter from the front lines provided a glimpse into the life of a medic who went on to receive a PhD after serving his country, during the worst airlift in history. She talks to Harvard Today about her work on veterans’ mental health.
I was the last straw. The humiliation came from the front lines. In the army, as a captain, I was given only a note of complaint and no feedback from my people. I was asked by the unit commander to report to his commanding officer. I was ordered to report to my superiors and to the brigade headquarters. No one was expecting me to be on the front lines of combat for days on end and in the face of continual enemy fire and missile attack.
But I took on the challenge.
It was then I realized what I was doing in the army and in my life. I was serving my country and my people. I saw it clearly and understood that the more I did, the more I saw. I was seeing that I had been sucked into the military-industrial complex—the gifts and the treacheries, the anxieties, the confusion, the lies, the subtle pressure to do everything, to go back and forth. But it was in the face of that noise, of that chaos, that I realized the greatest power I had is in me. It was then I realized I was the strongest person in the world. And that is when I got up and said, “No, I’m not going to keep the home fires burning in the back of my mind and I’m going to set them on fire. And that is when I understood the meaning of the word “Never give up.” And that is when I decided to take back the responsibility to myself.
For our medically vulnerable veterans, it’s the absence of resources, a lack of meaning, a lack of purpose, a lack of hope that can be catastrophic.
So, it took me a long time to figure out what I needed to do. I was a lieutenant who specialized in ground control, and I think I recognized that feeling of confusion and frustration that can be a self-fulfilling prophecy.
I got into this small way of doing and I started doing things on my own, and my people came back and said, “You are doing the right thing. You’re going to be the best military mind who is going to take over your command.” That meant I had to admit the mistake, and I had to say, “You made a mistake. I’ve got to do it a different way.” And I was saying, “No, you’re right. I’m going to do this differently. I’m going to do it differently. But I’m not going to let my people down. I’m going to do this differently.” I realized that’s a dangerous thing to do, but I’m going to make a difference.
As you know, we lost a lot of lives, and I think our service members — and our civilians and families — suffer at a very great price. We have a growing awareness that we must pay attention to the mentally ill and the sick in this country. For our medically vulnerable veterans, it’s the absence of resources, a lack of meaning, a lack of purpose, a lack of hope that can be catastrophic. Our society has disconnected its connection to nature, in a very real way. We’re losing a lot of lives, and I think our service members — and our civilians and families — suffer at a very great price.
The mission to restore and strengthen the world through love and devotion has always been at the heart of the Rhode Island Catholic Church. It’s called the Immaculate Conception. And there are two congregations here that have taken this mission as their mission. The first is Providence. And that’s where this program was started.
Hope is built on our faith in Jesus. Hope is built on the history of the Holy Spirit’s activity in the lives of the good people of God. I got to work in one of the most dangerous war zones, to see what all of the therapy and training that I was doing was being called on, which is critical. I remember standing outside in the middle of the city. I was the last person in the city. I was a spectator. I knew I was going to die. But I felt great. I was not afraid. I was not afraid of the fact that I might be shot.
I had to endure a lot of battles, and I had to endure a lot of ambushes and people trying to get to us. I had to endure it all on my own. And there was a point where I got tired of it and I got fed up. But I told my people, I was tired of it. So, one day, I said, “Okay, we’re tired. We’re going to give it up. But they said, “No, we won’t.
You’ve done the hardest thing for us. You got to keep going.” So, they took me to the city of Albany, where I got to see all of these bombed-out buildings and I was at peace with the worst things of all, because I knew I was going to die, but I got to see the world.
The work of faith is the struggle of hope. I always say, faith is not belief. It’s a creative struggle. It’s an action that leads us out of the dark and into the light. And that has been the mission of Rhode Island Catholic Church. That’s what God’s called us to do and I think the military is a fine example of the goal of Catholic church.
War, for many people, is a place where they make quick decisions. You might be talking to someone who has served in the Army or Navy, and they’ll say, “Well, we need to execute it right now, right now, right now.” And you know, there’s a period of three days. And it might take a while to say, “Okay, well, what did we learn? What’s the best way to take care of it, right now?” And I think that’s the opposite of what’s needed in this program. And it’s the opposite of what’s needed in this world.
We need people to have trust in one another. And trust is a vulnerable place, and you need to make sure it’s safe and the people are loved and are cared for and have support.
What are the most important things that you learned in your studies in theology and psychology, or whatever else you’ve learned?
Everybody here, for the most part, is far more skilled and far more knowledgeable in a particular area than I was. But what I want to talk about is the foundational work that we need to be doing as a society to keep all people safe. One of the things that I noticed, in all of the study that I did, it seemed that people who were doing a meaningful amount of spiritual work, and people who were making a lot of sacrifices for their community, the greater good of society, and the world, were very skilled, very knowledgeable, but they were also feeling very isolated.
When you’re feeling isolated, you’re not able to be courageous enough to face up to those feelings and not to be able to identify what you’re experiencing and how you can make a difference. When you’re feeling isolated, you feel like nobody cares and nobody’s listening to you.
I had a meeting with a group of soldiers who were talking to me about some of the things they were dealing with in Iraq. They were saying, “I feel like I’m in this place that nobody understands, that nobody cares about.” They had a goal in life to be something, but they didn’t see any reason to do anything beyond that. All they had in mind was the fight, and they didn’t know that there were any good things coming their way. And I think that feeling of isolation, of loneliness, can lead to a lot of depression.
The best thing to do is get people connected, so that when there’s an incident, when they see someone injured or dead or taken from us, they realize that somebody is connected to us. You can’t afford to think like that, you have to live that way. You’re not going to get anything from the military. You have to get something from each other. That’s what your spiritual life is. It’s a life of connection.
One of the big benefits of developing a warrior spirituality is that it will help people who are connected to each other, to know that they can identify in a different way with what’s going on, with the mission, with the history of the place, and that it’s more important to them to stand up and be part of the solution than to fight something that they don’t understand.
I think this program is the most significant breakthrough in military psychiatry. It’s a prevention model, but it’s also an opportunity for people to be connected. That’s what we need. It’s a place where we can come together. It’s a place where we can reaffirm our beliefs and our values.
Do you think that military culture is becoming more supportive of those issues?
I think so. I was doing it for 35 years. I can tell you that it’s a big step. It’s a way that you can be strong, and it’s a way you can be courageous and be part of the solution, and a way to overcome some of the dysfunction in the U.S. armed forces that has been going on for decades.
We have a need to do more work in the VA and we have to get the government to help the military. And that’s how we’re going to get better.
As a minister, as an activist, and in front of people, I’ve learned that you have to take a different look at the world and you have to recognize that there’s a lot of conflict and violence that’s going on in a lot of the world. And I’m in the last part of my military career, I’ve decided to do more with those people, so they can recognize the values that I’ve always felt about making a difference and being willing to do it for the right reasons.
It’s important that we see the world with people who are on the front lines of war, who are exposed to the harshness of life, who have seen some of the most destructive decisions.
We have to go there, help to get people connected, to get them connected to the humanity of the other, to get people to help us get them connected to themselves and that’s when we can take back the control of our lives. Set to a gripping soundtrack, My Old Grandma Kicks: The Story of a Modern American Chef was released in 2011 and won a shining prize in the 2011 Culinary Education Film Festival. The film received broad acclaim, garnering over 40 million views on YouTube. Over the next two years, the director's career took off, and My Old Grandma Kicks was nominated for the coveted TV Guide Award for Best Documentary, as well as several more international festivals, which resulted in over 700 screenings worldwide.
My Old Grandma Kicks: The Story of a Modern American Chef is a must see for any film buff!

Harris was running toward a Super Target store across the street when two police officers tried to arrest him. He allegedly opened fire on one officer, a 30-year-old male officer, and killed him, according to witnesses. Then, on arrival at the Walmart, Harris allegedly opened fire on a police tactical team that was waiting outside the store to take him into custody. Harris had a handgun in his hand, and he allegedly aimed it at the officers before the shooting.
Just over an hour later, Harris returned to the Walmart shooting. He allegedly stole a gun from a storage locker and had a shotgun in his hand before turning on two other officers, fatally wounding both of them, according to the Chicago Police Department.
Police said Harris also allegedly hit a handful of workers at the Walmart, causing some of them to suffer minor injuries.

An ancient map points to a location never before seen by researchers, new findings say.
Skeletons and waterline paintings dating back to the Roman period are helping investigators at the University of Leeds better understand the story of the Roman city of Silvium.
People lived on the site of Silvium for thousands of years, until its abandonment by Rome in AD 105. Excavation work has uncovered some of the most significant Roman settlements in Britain, including the famous baths of Bath, but no evidence of Silvium has been found.
Now, a new discovery of archaeological waterlogged river valleys in Silvium has led to evidence of Silvium’s existence – one of the largest archaeological discoveries in Europe.
The 2,400-year-old map, which shows the location of Silvium – as well as many other features – has allowed archaeologists to reconstruct a 2,200-year-old woman’s deformity and a 45-year-old man’s age, as well as some new elements of a woman’s facial reconstruction.
A senior author of the study, Professor Susan Donaldson of the University of Leeds, said: “These findings are crucial in helping us better understand the life of a Roman woman living in Silvium and their role in daily life.
“They are also important for scholars working with female visual archaeology, as they demonstrate the reliability of ancient scientific works like the Roman's Athenaeum and Julia Pestis, which are generally considered to be late medieval or modern in style.
“For future studies into the development of gender within society and its contribution to both the individual and the collective wellbeing, the discovery of ancient Silvium will be of particular interest.
“This, along with the success of other archaeological discoveries like the Bath Stone Age and the emergence of the Roman town of Tublotum, provide even more evidence that even in early Roman times, archaeology has a place in the culture.
“Lead author and Professor Donaldson, who led the team, said: “The fact that these ancient maps of Silvium could survive and exist for so long is testament to the value and the richness of the archaeology conducted here.
“To help us understand these everyday practices of living people, this research will be essential to the history of British archaeology and the processes of making sense of social change.
“This study demonstrates the vital role that archaeology can play in telling the history of places and the people who lived there,” said Professor Donaldson, who is also head of the Department of Archaeology.
This research was funded by the British Academy and Leeds Archaeology.

The first blooms of spring in the garden signal the beginning of summer’s flowers.
Many people associate the decline of the yellow flag iris as the end of the spring floral season in any gardens. In fact, these irises, along with other irises, scented and fall gardens, come into bloom at the beginning of May. Yellow flag irises are still small, however, and the beautiful color continues until the ends of the irises catch the light of the sun. This flower is not a hardy plant and should be cared for properly.
In fact, yellow flag irises need to be planted in full sun in cool and fertile ground and they will flourish in the sun when the temperature and soil conditions are right. While the yellow flag iris is the pretty flower on the garden, many gardeners would rather use the yellow flag iris as a cover for a more important crop on the garden. Yellow flag irises work well as a ground cover for the more important vegetables like peas, broccoli and cauliflower. In fact, you should add this crop to a list of crop rotations that work in the fall garden. Since the yellow flag iris is small and prefers a cool climate, the golden rule for growing this crop is to plant them in the spring when soil temperatures are higher.
Once the yellow flag iris is planted, the plant begins to send out buds in the spring. This means that the garden may be a bit wild during this time. To keep the garden tidy and to keep the yellown flag iris growing during this time, a summer fertilizer is applied to the garden. Fertilizer will encourage the iris to re- flower and help keep the large grass seed heads off the yellow flag iris. This type of fertilizer will also promote new growth in the garden.
If the yellow flag iris plants have spread to several areas of the garden, the fertilizer can be spread over the whole garden. This will encourage new plants in the garden, protect the grass seedheads, and limit the weeds that have grown along the edges of the garden. New plants will make the garden look beautiful and they are healthy. However, if the plants have spread to a large area of the garden, you should thin the weeds. This will give the yard a new look and make the grass healthy and less susceptible to disease. The mowing, removing or trimming of weeds will also help prevent pest problems.
When the beautiful yellow flag irises open their petals, the flower shuts itself off. In fact, it may be a surprise to your garden friend that the yellow flag iris grows back again.

The discovery of a rare species in the Amazon rainforest opens up discussions about the natural value of the rainforest.
Anyone who has travelled to Brazil’s Amazon rainforest and explored one of its most famous destinations, The Grand Canyon of the Amazon, knows of the unique species-rich diversity of the region.
Rare ecosystems can often be found in close proximity to the human impact on their biodiversity.
The rainforest in Brazil is home to one of the world’s most unique and diverse ecosystems, with over 200 endemic species and 100,000 varieties.
Knowing that many species – including the largest anaconda on the planet – are endangered, the people of Brazil have already started setting aside large areas of land to conserve these unique ecosystems.
Scientists have found more than 200 endemic species in the world’s Amazon rainforest.
A number of birds and mammals have also evolved in new ways as a result of these canopy additions, including nectar eating parrots and meerkats.
More than 2,500 years ago, a Portuguese explorer discovered The Amazon and was the first to name it after God.
The name Rio de Janeiro means the river of kings.
It was not until the 1950s that tourists first began to visit the region.
However, the area’s expansive nature, the lack of motorised vehicles and the numerous existing problems on the local highways mean that the region remains mostly undeveloped.
Fortunately, Brazil’s recent past has also seen some action taken by the authorities to increase sustainable tourism and safeguard the environment.
At the World Conservation Congress, representatives from all over the world met to discuss a new law, known as the Bill of Rights for Nature and Biodiversity, which was passed in 2018.
The new legislation is designed to allow for the conservation and sustainable management of nature and biodiversity, including the more threatened species.
This is due to be implemented across the world with more than 40 countries now involved.
The first step to implementing this bill was the identification of 30 protected areas, the equivalent to the entire country of Ireland.
Protected areas cover an estimated 1.6m square kilometres.
Among them are 11 national parks and one marine park.
The Aranyas forest canopy is one of the largest and most unique ecosystems in the world.
Its majestic vegetation has been subject to human invasion for thousands of years and is home to hundreds of species.
The 250km² rainforest, which covers an area larger than Northern Ireland, is a biological and cultural heritage of mankind.
This tree growing in the centre of the Amazon rainforest is one of the most valuable wildlife species on earth.
Much of this biological heritage is being threatened by commercial exploitation and over-grazing.
This resulted in the death of up to 1,100 species in the last five decades.
The animals killed include jaguars, pumas, tapirs, anacondas, parrots and kingfishers, to name a few.
A small number of species such as the giant cormorant, the black-capped capuchin and the red wooly monkey have benefited from increased habitat habitat.
However, many other species are in decline, as canopy additions, dam construction and agricultural practices often lead to the destruction of their natural habitat.
“The Brazilian people were the first to save nature, they must now keep going,” said French President Emmanuel Macron, who was the guest of honour at the summit.
The country’s symbolic president, Michel Temer, and its most recent president, Jair Bolsonaro, who will also be the guest of honour at the event, are due to attend.
Ms Temer, 71, has been named Brazil’s favourite by a number of polls for the next 20 years.
An unfinished list of biodiversity victories is expected to be completed in the next few years.
The Brazilian national park of Serra do Jade was recently labelled as one of the most biodiverse in the world.
In one year, the forest has recorded 77 new species of vertebrates, 130 new plants, 53 species of lichens and 65 species of mosses.
Species protection in the Serra do Jade has also been aided by the presence of avian monitoring stations across the forest.
One of the most endangered trees in the world, the monkeydove is a rare, magical bird with its voice having once been used for philanthropy and as a source of inspiration for paintings.
A network of trails built by the indigenous population of the rainforest will be used to teach visitors the plants and animals that are found in the forest, allowing them to understand its significance.
Visitors can also check out satellite mapping which will show the conservation efforts of the region and provide information about natural resources.
“I hope this new legislation will not only save the forest and its species, but also attract more tourists to visit Brazil, and make the country’s biodiversity important in terms of the tourism industry,” said Brazilian delegate Carlos Cacciapiccola.
In the meantime, the amazing beauty of the Amazon rainforest is slowly becoming a reality to millions of tourists.

The final rehearsal before the big performance reveals the true talent of the new six piece band. There are some who grumble about the the audition process being tough and unfair to others who worked there first. The ones who did, have to accept that they are in the same spot as the other job applicants who didn’t make it to the audition but who had more time to learn songs. When it’s a big rehearsal, the band can let the rest of the group go in the other room to do their own rehearsal.
After the audition, I had been working on songs for the band. We were a couple weeks ahead on the season-opening gig in Mountain View. We usually play one big show a month, plus local gigs and then the season closes with another big show in early June. When the first show is in June, we have time to work on the group, filling in gaps, fine tuning, finishing the set lists, and getting ready for the show. At the end of the season, however, we go back to doing the same job on every rehearsal set and then to the same set list, whether we make it or not.
It seemed unfair that one person could not make it and be rejected just because of the time he had to prepare his own songs. The admissions process for bands is long, and you don’t get to the final audition and the second chance without preparing your own songs. The band members would eventually get a fair trial if one person was dropped.
The process was what it was. My boys won’t remember much, because they were a team. We played well together, with each other’s backs, and learned from each other’s mistakes and successes. When someone passed through the gate, I was disappointed, but proud to see someone get a second chance to show what they could do.
I’ve been thinking a lot about how unfair the audition process is.
It’s unfair that many of the people who apply for the role don’t have much time to prepare a song and then become rejected because they didn’t get a chance. Or that they pass through the audition and then lose out to people who have more time to prepare their songs.
It’s unfair that auditionees with the time and talent to prepare their songs don’t get a second chance. Or that an opportunity to get a seat in the band was awarded to someone who only completed the first audition and didn’t show what he could do.
It’s unfair to encourage people to put in the effort, even if they can’t win the audition, because those who won the audition may be more predisposed to become future band members. I’ve seen the same happen in some other places.
It’s unfair to give auditioners the chance to prepare songs before an audition, and to only give the winner of that audition a chance to perform at the audition.
There’s probably a lot more it’s unfair than the process I have written about here.
My wish for the audition is that it’s the same for everyone. But we also have to figure out a way to get the audience for each show. We know it’s going to be a big show, and we’ve put in the time to do our best, even though our songs are inferior to most other bands in the San Francisco Bay Area.
So I don’t know how we’ll go about making it, but in the mean time, I wonder if anyone in the comments has had to put in a lot of work to get a shot in a band you may have to wait a long time for. Has anyone had to put in a lot of effort to get a second chance?
